title: AVIA AMA · MCP-поиски и тарифы
description: Продовые поиски авиабилетов через MCP, подготовленные карточки и условия обмена и возврата в ответах. Даты и границы месяца указаны по Москве.

panels.title: Авиапоиски за период
panels.description: Уникальные поиски в проде за выбранный период. Дата поиска — первый старт, при отсутствии старта — первое финальное событие. Повторы одного запроса считаются один раз.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT request_id,
         min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started') AS started_at,
         coalesce(min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started'), min(client_timestamp)) AS first_seen,
         bool_or(request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR coalesce(payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp', false)) AS is_mcp
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY request_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM runs WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Все каналы", count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_mcp) AS "MCP" FROM cohort

panels.title: Доля MCP среди авиапоисков
panels.description: Число уникальных MCP-поисков, делённое на число всех уникальных авиапоисков продукта в проде за период. Если поисков не было, доля не определена.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT request_id,
         min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started') AS started_at,
         coalesce(min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started'), min(client_timestamp)) AS first_seen,
         bool_or(request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR coalesce(payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp', false)) AS is_mcp
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY request_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM runs WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_mcp) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM cohort

panels.title: MCP-поиски, где нашлись билеты
panels.description: По последнему событию поиска к концу периода система подготовила хотя бы один вариант перелёта.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT request_id,
         min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started') AS started_at,
         coalesce(min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started'), min(client_timestamp)) AS first_seen,
         bool_or(request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR coalesce(payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp', false)) AS is_mcp
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY request_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM runs WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()
), latest AS (
  SELECT c.*, e.client_timestamp AS last_at, e.type, e.payload->'scenario' AS p
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT type, client_timestamp, payload
    FROM events e
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.request_id = c.request_id AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
      AND e.type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    ORDER BY e.client_timestamp DESC, e.received_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
  ) e
  WHERE c.is_mcp
), results AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.completed' AND p->>'tickets_shown' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
              THEN (p->>'tickets_shown')::int END AS tickets,
         CASE WHEN type IN ('scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed') AND started_at IS NOT NULL
              THEN extract(epoch FROM last_at - started_at)
              WHEN type IN ('scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed') AND p->'timings_ms'->>'total' ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
              THEN (p->'timings_ms'->>'total')::numeric / 1000 END AS seconds
  FROM latest
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE tickets > 0) AS value FROM results

panels.title: Авиапоиски по дням
panels.description: Уникальные запросы по московским датам. Первая и последняя даты учитывают только выбранное время. Канал MCP определяется по признаку в событии или историческому префиксу идентификатора.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT request_id,
         min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started') AS started_at,
         coalesce(min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started'), min(client_timestamp)) AS first_seen,
         bool_or(request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR coalesce(payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp', false)) AS is_mcp
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY request_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM runs WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()
), days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
                         date_trunc('day', ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '1 microsecond') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
                         interval '1 day') AS day
)
SELECT greatest(d.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS "time",
       count(c.request_id) FILTER (WHERE c.is_mcp) AS "MCP",
       count(c.request_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.is_mcp) AS "Другие каналы"
FROM days d LEFT JOIN cohort c ON (c.first_seen AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date = d.day::date
GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Чем завершились MCP-поиски
panels.description: Исходы на конец выбранного периода по дате первого старта (МСК). Категория «До выдачи / без счётчика» включает ранние завершения, в том числе запросы с недостающими данными.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT request_id,

         coalesce(min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started'), min(client_timestamp)) AS first_seen,
         bool_or(request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR coalesce(payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp', false)) AS is_mcp
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY request_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM runs WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()
), latest AS (
  SELECT c.*, e.client_timestamp AS last_at, e.type, e.payload->'scenario' AS p
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT type, client_timestamp, payload
    FROM events e
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.request_id = c.request_id AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
      AND e.type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    ORDER BY e.client_timestamp DESC, e.received_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
  ) e
  WHERE c.is_mcp
), results AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.completed' AND p->>'tickets_shown' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
              THEN (p->>'tickets_shown')::int END AS tickets,
         CASE WHEN type IN ('scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed') AND started_at IS NOT NULL
              THEN extract(epoch FROM last_at - started_at)
              WHEN type IN ('scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed') AND p->'timings_ms'->>'total' ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
              THEN (p->'timings_ms'->>'total')::numeric / 1000 END AS seconds
  FROM latest
), days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
                         date_trunc('day', ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '1 microsecond') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
                         interval '1 day') AS day
)
SELECT greatest(d.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS "time",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE tickets > 0) AS "Есть билеты",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE tickets = 0 AND nullif(p->>'early_return_reason', '') IS NULL) AS "Без билетов",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.completed' AND coalesce(tickets, 0) = 0 AND (tickets IS NULL OR nullif(p->>'early_return_reason', '') IS NOT NULL)) AS "До выдачи / без счётчика",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.failed') AS "Ошибка",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started') AS "Нет финального события"
FROM days d LEFT JOIN results r ON (r.first_seen AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date = d.day::date
GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Последние MCP-поиски
panels.description: До 100 запросов по убыванию времени первого старта. Маршрут показан кодами IATA, время — в секундах до последнего исхода. Знак «/» обозначает разрыв между сегментами маршрута. Пустая ячейка означает, что поле не пришло в телеметрию. Количество билетов относится к готовой подборке до ограничения выдачи MCP.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT request_id,
         min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started') AS started_at,
         coalesce(min(client_timestamp) FILTER (WHERE type = 'scenario.started'), min(client_timestamp)) AS first_seen,
         bool_or(request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR coalesce(payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp', false)) AS is_mcp
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY request_id
), cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM runs WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()
), latest AS (
  SELECT c.*, e.client_timestamp AS last_at, e.type, e.payload->'scenario' AS p
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT type, client_timestamp, payload
    FROM events e
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.request_id = c.request_id AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
      AND e.type IN ('scenario.started', 'scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed')
    ORDER BY e.client_timestamp DESC, e.received_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
  ) e
  WHERE c.is_mcp
), results AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.completed' AND p->>'tickets_shown' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
              THEN (p->>'tickets_shown')::int END AS tickets,
         CASE WHEN type IN ('scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed') AND started_at IS NOT NULL
              THEN extract(epoch FROM last_at - started_at)
              WHEN type IN ('scenario.completed', 'scenario.failed') AND p->'timings_ms'->>'total' ~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
              THEN (p->'timings_ms'->>'total')::numeric / 1000 END AS seconds
  FROM latest
), routes AS (
  SELECT *,
         substring(split_part(p->>'aviasales_url', '?', 1)
                   FROM '^https://(?:www[.])?aviasales[.]ru/search/([A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{3}(?:-?[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{3}|[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{3})*(?:[0-9]{4})?[cwf]?[0-9]+)$') AS path
  FROM results
)
SELECT first_seen AS "Время",
       CASE WHEN path ~ '^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}[cwf]?[0-9]+$'
            THEN left(path,3) || ' ↔ ' || substr(path,8,3)
            WHEN path IS NOT NULL
            THEN replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(path, '[0-9]*[cwf]?[0-9]+$', ''), '[0-9]{4}', ' → ', 'g'), '-', ' / ')
            WHEN p->>'origin' ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND p->>'destination' ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
            THEN (p->>'origin') || ' → ' || (p->>'destination') END AS "Маршрут",
       CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.started' THEN 'Нет финального события'
            WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' THEN 'Ошибка'
            WHEN tickets > 0 THEN 'Есть билеты'
            WHEN nullif(p->>'early_return_reason','') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Завершён до выдачи'
            WHEN tickets = 0 THEN 'Без билетов'
            ELSE 'Число билетов неизвестно' END AS "Исход",
       tickets AS "Подготовлено билетов", round(seconds, 1) AS "Секунды",
       CASE p->>'fare_rules_timed_out' WHEN 'true' THEN 'Да' WHEN 'false' THEN 'Нет' END AS "Тайм-аут правил",
       CASE WHEN coalesce(p->>'early_return_reason', p->>'tickets_zero_reason') ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$'
            THEN coalesce(p->>'early_return_reason', p->>'tickets_zero_reason') END AS "Код причины",
       CASE WHEN request_id ~ '^mcp-([[:xdigit:]]{32}|[[:xdigit:]]{8}(-[[:xdigit:]]{4}){3}-[[:xdigit:]]{12})$'
            THEN request_id ELSE 'ref-' || md5(request_id) END AS "ID поиска"
FROM routes ORDER BY first_seen DESC, request_id LIMIT 100

panels.title: Подготовленные карточки
panels.description: Все билеты в сводках завершённых MCP-поисков за период. Один поиск учитывается один раз по последнему завершению. В одну подборку может входить больше билетов, чем вернул MCP.

targets.rawSql:
WITH completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id)
         request_id, client_timestamp AS finished_at, payload->'scenario' AS run
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type = 'scenario.completed'
    AND (request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY request_id, client_timestamp DESC, received_at DESC, event_id DESC
), measured AS (
  SELECT finished_at, run, run->'card_fares_summary' AS summary
  FROM completions WHERE finished_at >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT sum((summary->>'cards')::integer) AS "Всего", sum((summary->>'with_refund_shown')::integer) AS "Возврат известен" FROM measured
WHERE summary ? 'with_refund_shown' AND summary ? 'cards'

panels.title: Возврат известен в карточке
panels.description: Доля подготовленных карточек с явным условием возврата. Учитывается и запрет возврата. Знаменатель — все карточки со сводкой покрытия.

targets.rawSql:
WITH completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id)
         request_id, client_timestamp AS finished_at, payload->'scenario' AS run
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type = 'scenario.completed'
    AND (request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY request_id, client_timestamp DESC, received_at DESC, event_id DESC
), measured AS (
  SELECT finished_at, run, run->'card_fares_summary' AS summary
  FROM completions WHERE finished_at >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT round(100.0 * sum((summary->>'with_refund_shown')::integer) / nullif(sum((summary->>'cards')::integer), 0), 2) AS "Возврат" FROM measured
WHERE summary ? 'with_refund_shown' AND summary ? 'cards'

panels.title: Возврат установлен по правилам OneTwoTrip
panels.description: Доля всех подготовленных карточек, для которых разбор правил дал статус возврата. Правила могут быть получены из кэша. При отображении карточка также может использовать информацию о тарифном бренде.

targets.rawSql:
WITH completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id)
         request_id, client_timestamp AS finished_at, payload->'scenario' AS run
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type = 'scenario.completed'
    AND (request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY request_id, client_timestamp DESC, received_at DESC, event_id DESC
), measured AS (
  SELECT finished_at, run, run->'card_fares_summary' AS summary
  FROM completions WHERE finished_at >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(coalesce((summary->'by_refund_src'->>'rules')::integer, 0)) / nullif(sum((summary->>'cards')::integer), 0), 2) AS "По правилам" FROM measured
WHERE summary ? 'with_refund_shown' AND summary ? 'cards'

panels.title: Поиски с тайм-аутом загрузки правил
panels.description: Число завершённых поисков, в которых истекло время загрузки тарифных правил. Тайм-аут может затронуть часть карточек успешного поиска. При отсутствии измерений значение пустое.

targets.rawSql:
WITH completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id)
         request_id, client_timestamp AS finished_at, payload->'scenario' AS run
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type = 'scenario.completed'
    AND (request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY request_id, client_timestamp DESC, received_at DESC, event_id DESC
), measured AS (
  SELECT finished_at, run, run->'card_fares_summary' AS summary
  FROM completions WHERE finished_at >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (run->>'fare_rules_timed_out')::boolean) AS "Поиски"
FROM measured WHERE run ? 'fare_rules_timed_out'
HAVING count(*) > 0

panels.title: Покрытие возврата по дням
panels.description: Московский день завершения поиска. Обе доли рассчитаны от суммы подготовленных карточек за день. Дни без измерений пропускаются.

targets.rawSql:
WITH completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id)
         request_id, client_timestamp AS finished_at, payload->'scenario' AS run
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type = 'scenario.completed'
    AND (request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY request_id, client_timestamp DESC, received_at DESC, event_id DESC
), measured AS (
  SELECT finished_at, run, run->'card_fares_summary' AS summary
  FROM completions WHERE finished_at >= $__timeFrom()
)
, daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AS day,
         round(100.0 * sum((summary->>'with_refund_shown')::integer) / nullif(sum((summary->>'cards')::integer), 0), 2) AS refund_pct,
         round(100.0 * sum(coalesce((summary->'by_refund_src'->>'rules')::integer, 0)) / nullif(sum((summary->>'cards')::integer), 0), 2) AS rules_pct FROM measured
WHERE summary ? 'with_refund_shown' AND summary ? 'cards'
  GROUP BY 1
), days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
    date_trunc('day', ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '1 microsecond') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow'),
    interval '1 day'
  ) AS day WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily)
)
SELECT greatest(days.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time,
       refund_pct AS "Возврат известен", rules_pct AS "Есть статус из правил OneTwoTrip"
FROM days LEFT JOIN daily USING (day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Загрузка правил OneTwoTrip по дням
panels.description: Поиски и тайм-ауты считаются по завершённым MCP-поискам с включёнными правилами. Остальные счётчики показывают операции при получении правил. «Без ответа» и «Пустые правила» приходят из разных полей телеметрии.

targets.rawSql:
WITH completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id)
         request_id, client_timestamp AS finished_at, payload->'scenario' AS run
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type = 'scenario.completed'
    AND (request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY request_id, client_timestamp DESC, received_at DESC, event_id DESC
), measured AS (
  SELECT finished_at, run, run->'card_fares_summary' AS summary
  FROM completions WHERE finished_at >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' AS "День",
       count(*) AS "Поисков",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (run->>'fare_rules_timed_out')::boolean) AS "С тайм-аутом",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_requested')::integer) AS "Запрошено",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_with_status')::integer) AS "Со статусом",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_cache_hits')::integer) AS "Из кэша правил",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_llm_cache_hits')::integer) AS "Из кэша разбора",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_empty_rules')::integer) AS "Пустые правила",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_no_response')::integer) AS "Без ответа",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_errors')::integer) AS "Ошибок",
       sum((run->>'fare_rules_budget_skip')::integer) AS "Пропущено по бюджету",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (run->>'fare_rules_captcha')::boolean OR (run->>'fare_rules_cooldown_skip')::boolean) AS "Поисков с капчей или паузой"
FROM measured WHERE run ? 'fare_rules_requested'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Возврат по перевозчикам и тарифам в подготовленных карточках
panels.description: Разбивка по карточкам из журналов завершённых поисков. Детализация сохраняет первые 40 карточек каждого поиска, а сводные показатели выше учитывают все карточки. Комбинации перевозчиков и кодов тарифа сохраняются вместе.

targets.rawSql:
WITH completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id)
         request_id, client_timestamp AS finished_at, payload->'scenario' AS run
  FROM events
  WHERE service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND system_env = 'prod'
    AND type = 'scenario.completed'
    AND (request_id LIKE 'mcp-%' OR payload->'scenario'->>'channel' = 'mcp')
    AND nullif(request_id, '') IS NOT NULL AND client_timestamp < $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY request_id, client_timestamp DESC, received_at DESC, event_id DESC
), measured AS (
  SELECT finished_at, run, run->'card_fares_summary' AS summary
  FROM completions WHERE finished_at >= $__timeFrom()
)
SELECT coalesce(nullif(array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(c->'carriers')), ' + '), ''), 'Не указан') AS "Перевозчики",
       coalesce(nullif(array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(nullif(c->'fare_codes', 'null'::jsonb))), ' / '), ''), 'Не указан') AS "Коды тарифа",
       coalesce(nullif(c->>'brand', ''), 'Не указан') AS "Бренд",
       count(*) AS "Карточек",
       count(c->>'refund_shown') AS "С возвратом",
       round(100.0 * count(c->>'refund_shown') / count(*), 2) AS "Покрытие возврата",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c->>'refund_src' = 'rules') AS "Статус из правил"
FROM measured
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(run->'card_fares') AS c
WHERE summary ? 'with_refund_shown' AND c ? 'refund_shown'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1, 2, 3

panels.title: Возврат и обмен в ответах MCP · с начала записи покрытия
В скольких карточках показаны условия
panels.description: Доля уникальных карточек первичной выдачи MCP с явно указанным условием. Запрет возврата или обмена тоже считается известным условием. Знаменатель у трёх показателей общий. Источником служит событие mcp.fare_coverage. Для периодов без таких карточек процент не рассчитывается.

targets.rawSql:
WITH in_range AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.request_id
    FROM events e
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.request_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' = 'search'
      AND e.client_timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), observations AS (
    SELECT e.request_id, e.client_timestamp, e.received_at, e.event_id,
           e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' AS stage, c->>'card_id' AS card_id, c AS card
    FROM events e
    JOIN in_range r ON r.request_id = e.request_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'scenario'->'cards') c
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' = 'search'
      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id, stage, card_id)
           request_id, stage, card,
           min(client_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, stage, card_id) AS first_seen
    FROM observations
    ORDER BY request_id, stage, card_id,
             CASE WHEN stage = 'followup' THEN client_timestamp END DESC,
             client_timestamp, received_at, event_id
), cards AS (
    SELECT request_id, stage, first_seen, card,
           coalesce(card->>'refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS refund,
           coalesce(card->>'exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS exchange,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_refund,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_exchange
    FROM dedup
    WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
)
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE refund) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS "Возврат",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE exchange) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS "Обмен",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE refund AND exchange) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS "Оба условия"
FROM cards
HAVING count(*) > 0

           coalesce(card->>'collected_exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_exchange
    FROM dedup

), daily AS (

               interval '1 day'
           ) AS day

       )
       SELECT greatest(days.day AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time,

       FROM days LEFT JOIN daily d USING (day)

panels.title: Сколько условий удалось собрать и показать
panels.description: Все значения — количества. Поиск учитывается, если в нём зафиксирована хотя бы одна карточка на этом этапе. Для первичной выдачи берётся первое наблюдение каждой карточки, для уточнения — последнее до конца периода. На обоих этапах карточка относится к моменту первого появления на своём этапе. targets.rawSql:

      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id, stage, card_id)
           request_id, stage, card,
           min(client_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, stage, card_id) AS first_seen
    FROM observations
    ORDER BY request_id, stage, card_id,
             CASE WHEN stage = 'followup' THEN client_timestamp END DESC,
             client_timestamp, received_at, event_id

    SELECT request_id, stage, first_seen, card,
           coalesce(card->>'refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS refund,
           coalesce(card->>'exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS exchange,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_refund,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_exchange

SELECT CASE stage WHEN 'search' THEN 'Первичная выдача' ELSE 'Уточнение' END AS "Этап",
       count(DISTINCT request_id) AS "Поисков", count(*) AS "Карточек",

panels.title: Возврат и обмен по каждому MCP-поиску
panels.description: До 100 последних сочетаний поиска и этапа в интервале. Идентификатор совпадает с таблицей последних поисков. Время указано по первому появлению карточки на этом этапе в выбранном периоде. Повторные чтения карточки на этапе учитываются один раз.

targets.rawSql:
WITH in_range AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.request_id
    FROM events e
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.request_id IS NOT NULL

), observations AS (
    SELECT e.request_id, e.client_timestamp, e.received_at, e.event_id,
           e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' AS stage, c->>'card_id' AS card_id, c AS card
    FROM events e
    JOIN in_range r ON r.request_id = e.request_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'scenario'->'cards') c
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' IN ('search', 'followup')
      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id, stage, card_id)
           request_id, stage, card,
           min(client_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, stage, card_id) AS first_seen
    FROM observations
    ORDER BY request_id, stage, card_id,
             CASE WHEN stage = 'followup' THEN client_timestamp END DESC,
             client_timestamp, received_at, event_id
), cards AS (
    SELECT request_id, stage, first_seen, card,
           coalesce(card->>'refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS refund,

    FROM dedup

)
SELECT min(first_seen) AS "Время",
       CASE WHEN request_id ~ '^mcp-([[:xdigit:]]{32}|[[:xdigit:]]{8}(-[[:xdigit:]]{4}){3}-[[:xdigit:]]{12})$'
            THEN request_id ELSE 'ref-' || md5(request_id) END AS "ID поиска",
       CASE stage WHEN 'search' THEN 'Первичная выдача' ELSE 'Уточнение' END AS "Этап",
       count(*) AS "Карточек",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE refund) AS "Возврат показан",

panels.title: Покрытие по перевозчикам и тарифам
panels.description: Одна строка соответствует этапу, сочетанию перевозчиков, кодам тарифа по направлениям и бренду. Последняя карточка — время последнего нового наблюдения в группе по дате первого появления карточки на этапе. Проценты рассчитаны от числа карточек в строке. Прочерк означает, что идентификатор отсутствовал в событии.

targets.rawSql:
WITH in_range AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.request_id
    FROM events e
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.request_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' IN ('search', 'followup')
      AND e.client_timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), observations AS (
    SELECT e.request_id, e.client_timestamp, e.received_at, e.event_id,
           e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' AS stage, c->>'card_id' AS card_id, c AS card
    FROM events e
    JOIN in_range r ON r.request_id = e.request_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'scenario'->'cards') c
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' IN ('search', 'followup')
      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id, stage, card_id)
           request_id, stage, card,
           min(client_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, stage, card_id) AS first_seen
    FROM observations
    ORDER BY request_id, stage, card_id,
             CASE WHEN stage = 'followup' THEN client_timestamp END DESC,
             client_timestamp, received_at, event_id
), cards AS (
    SELECT request_id, stage, first_seen, card,
           coalesce(card->>'refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS refund,
           coalesce(card->>'exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS exchange,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_refund,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_exchange
    FROM dedup
    WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
), fares AS (
           SELECT stage, nullif(array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(card->'carriers')), ', '), '') AS carriers,
                  nullif(array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(card->'fare_codes')), ' → '), '') AS codes,
                  card->>'brand' AS brand, request_id, first_seen, refund, exchange
           FROM cards
       )
       SELECT CASE stage WHEN 'search' THEN 'Первичная выдача' ELSE 'Уточнение' END AS "Этап",
              coalesce(carriers, '—') AS "Перевозчики", coalesce(codes, '—') AS "Коды тарифа",
              coalesce(brand, '—') AS "Бренд", max(first_seen) AS "Последняя карточка",
              count(DISTINCT request_id) AS "Поисков", count(*) AS "Карточек",
              round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE refund) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS "Возврат",
round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE exchange) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS "Обмен",
round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE refund AND exchange) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS "Оба условия"
       FROM fares
       GROUP BY stage, carriers, codes, brand
       ORDER BY count(*) DESC, stage DESC, carriers, codes, brand

panels.title: Источники условий и результаты по каждой операции
panels.description: Карточка даёт по одной записи для возврата и обмена на каждом этапе. Источник относится к собранному условию, даже если само условие не попало в ответ. Первые пять статусов описывают то, что увидел пользователь. В последних двух колонках разделены известное, но не показанное условие и отсутствие самого условия. Сумма семи колонок равна числу карточек в строке.

targets.rawSql:
WITH in_range AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.request_id
    FROM events e
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.request_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' IN ('search', 'followup')
      AND e.client_timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), observations AS (
    SELECT e.request_id, e.client_timestamp, e.received_at, e.event_id,
           e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' AS stage, c->>'card_id' AS card_id, c AS card
    FROM events e
    JOIN in_range r ON r.request_id = e.request_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'scenario'->'cards') c
    WHERE e.service = 'AMA_avia_project' AND e.system_env = 'prod'
      AND e.type = 'mcp.fare_coverage' AND e.payload->'scenario'->>'stage' IN ('search', 'followup')
      AND e.client_timestamp < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
), dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (request_id, stage, card_id)
           request_id, stage, card,
           min(client_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, stage, card_id) AS first_seen
    FROM observations
    ORDER BY request_id, stage, card_id,
             CASE WHEN stage = 'followup' THEN client_timestamp END DESC,
             client_timestamp, received_at, event_id
), cards AS (
    SELECT request_id, stage, first_seen, card,
           coalesce(card->>'refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS refund,
           coalesce(card->>'exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS exchange,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_refund', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_refund,
           coalesce(card->>'collected_exchange', 'unknown') <> 'unknown' AS collected_exchange
    FROM dedup
    WHERE first_seen >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
), operations AS (
    SELECT stage, op.name, op.value, op.collected, coalesce(op.source, 'unknown') AS source
    FROM cards
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        ('Возврат', coalesce(card->>'refund', 'unknown'), collected_refund, card->>'refund_source'),
        ('Обмен', coalesce(card->>'exchange', 'unknown'), collected_exchange, card->>'exchange_source')
    ) AS op(name, value, collected, source)
)
SELECT CASE stage WHEN 'search' THEN 'Первичная выдача' ELSE 'Уточнение' END AS "Этап", name AS "Операция",
       CASE source WHEN 'rules' THEN 'Правила перевозчика' WHEN 'brand' THEN 'Бренд тарифа'
                   WHEN 'search' THEN 'Поисковая выдача' ELSE 'Не определён' END AS "Источник",
       count(*) AS "Карточек",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 'free') AS "Без штрафа",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 'with_penalty') AS "Со штрафом",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 'no') AS "Запрещено",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 'mixed') AS "Зависит от участка",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 'allowed') AS "Разрешено без уточнения",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 'unknown' AND collected) AS "Собрано, но не показано",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 'unknown' AND NOT collected) AS "Не собрано"
FROM operations
GROUP BY stage, name, source
ORDER BY stage DESC, name, count(*) DESC, source
